

===== FILE: .\frontend\style.css =====

/*
 * =========================================================
 * EasyChatBot Main Dashboard
 * =========================================================
 *
 * Core dashboard structure and presentation.
 *
 * Character-specific visual identity is supplied separately
 * by character-theme.css through CSS variables generated by
 * the backend Character Theme System.
 *
 * This file therefore defines:
 *
 * - dashboard layout
 * - sidebar
 * - navigation
 * - header
 * - cards
 * - companion hero
 * - progress
 * - missions
 * - academy
 * - recommendations
 * - responsive behaviour
 *
 * It does NOT define individual character themes.
 *
 * =========================================================
 */


/* =========================================================
   FOUNDATION
   ========================================================= */

:root {

    --ecb-core-background: #f5f7fb;
    --ecb-core-surface: #ffffff;
    --ecb-core-surface-alt: #f8f9fc;

    --ecb-core-text: #20243a;
    --ecb-core-text-muted: #73798f;
    --ecb-core-border: #e8eaf1;

    --ecb-core-primary: #6d5dfc;
    --ecb-core-primary-dark: #5748dc;

    --ecb-sidebar-width: 250px;

    --ecb-radius-small: 10px;
    --ecb-radius-medium: 16px;
    --ecb-radius-large: 24px;

    --ecb-shadow-soft:
        0 8px 30px rgba(30, 35, 60, 0.06);

    --ecb-shadow-card:
        0 12px 35px rgba(30, 35, 60, 0.07);

    --ecb-transition:
        180ms ease;

}


* {

    box-sizing: border-box;

}


html {

    min-height: 100%;

}


body {

    min-height: 100vh;

    margin: 0;

    font-family:
        Inter,
        ui-sans-serif,
        system-ui,
        -apple-system,
        BlinkMacSystemFont,
        "Segoe UI",
        sans-serif;

    color:
        var(
            --ecb-character-text-primary,
            var(--ecb-core-text)
        );

    background:
        var(
            --ecb-character-background,
            var(--ecb-core-background)
        );

    transition:
        background 250ms ease,
        color 250ms ease;

}


button,
input,
textarea {

    font: inherit;

}


button {

    cursor: pointer;

}


a {

    color: inherit;

    text-decoration: none;

}

/* EasyChatBot Character Theme Layer
   Loaded after style.css.
   Character palettes remain backend-controlled. */

:root {
    --ecb-character-primary: #2563eb;
    --ecb-character-secondary: #123b8a;
    --ecb-character-accent: #16a34a;
    --ecb-character-background: #eef4ff;
    --ecb-character-surface: #ffffff;
    --ecb-character-surface-alt: #f8fafc;
    --ecb-character-text-primary: #172033;
    --ecb-character-text-secondary: #64748b;
    --ecb-character-highlight: #eff6ff;
    --ecb-character-atmosphere: transparent;
    --ecb-theme-transition: 280ms ease;
}

body,
.brand-badge,
header h1,
.character,
#characters button,
.notification,
.notification-icon,
.notification-label,
.notification-action,
.eyebrow,
.character-badge,
.product-card,
.product-image,
.price,
.discount,
.relevance-list span,
.primary-action,
.secondary-action,
.chat,
.chat-button,
pre {
    transition:
        background var(--ecb-theme-transition),
        background-color var(--ecb-theme-transition),
        border-color var(--ecb-theme-transition),
        color var(--ecb-theme-transition),
        box-shadow var(--ecb-theme-transition);
}

body {
    background:
        radial-gradient(
            circle at 90% 5%,
            color-mix(in srgb, var(--ecb-character-secondary) 14%, transparent),
            transparent 34%
        ),
        linear-gradient(
            135deg,
            var(--ecb-character-background),
            var(--ecb-character-surface-alt)
        );
    color: var(--ecb-character-text-primary);
}

}

    color: var(--ecb-character-primary);
}

}

}
